values.basis: CDP Bazaar discovery search, one row per listed resource, capped at twenty results
paid operations declared by the store's own openapi.json (x-payment-info)
tools crawled by Agent402 from the store manifest; paidToolCount is the comparable figure
endpoints vet402 has observed for the host with catalog_status listed
matches reported by the x402-trust keyword search across its own index (listed and delisted)

payload.explanation: Bazaar search is capped at twenty results and lists one row per resource; the store openapi declares paid operations; Agent402 counts tools including free ones (paidToolCount is the comparable figure); vet402 counts every endpoint it has observed for the host with catalog_status listed, which can include routes the store no longer declares; x402-trust search counts matches across its own index. In this capture vet402 lists /api/maintenance-helper and /api/preparar-solicitud, which the store openapi does not declare as paid operations; that accounts for the whole difference between the vet402 and openapi counts.
